Title: Residence Card only (foreign resident): "Next" becomes enabled
Preconditions: Signed in to the portal; on https://agents.agentsonly.com/account-creation, step 1 "Personal Info"; all other step 1 fields filled with valid data; candidate is a foreign resident without a Cartão de Cidadão
Steps:
1. Leave "Cartão de Cidadão (Citizen Card)" empty.
2. Enter a valid number in "Residence Card (Número do Cartão/Título de Residência)".
3. Check the "Next" ("Próximo") button.
Test data:
"Cartão de Cidadão (Citizen Card)": (empty)
"Residence Card (Número do Cartão/Título de Residência)": FAKE-TR X0000000X (fictitious, not a real number); the real run used the reporter's own permit number
Expected result: No error on "Cartão de Cidadão (Citizen Card)"; "Next" is enabled and leads to step 2 "Identity Verification".
Actual result: "Cartão de Cidadão (Citizen Card)" shows "Required" ("Obrigatório"); "Next" stays disabled. Candidate cannot continue.

Title: Both document fields empty: "Next" disabled, clear error shown
Preconditions: Signed in to the portal; on https://agents.agentsonly.com/account-creation, step 1 "Personal Info"; all other step 1 fields filled with valid data
Steps:
1. Click into "Cartão de Cidadão (Citizen Card)", then click into "Residence Card (Número do Cartão/Título de Residência)" without typing.
2. Leave both empty.
3. Check the errors and "Next".
Expected result: "Next" is disabled; an error tells the user that one of the two documents is required.
Actual result: "Next" is disabled; "Cartão de Cidadão (Citizen Card)" shows "Required". The message does not mention that a Residence Card is an alternative.
Notes: The disabled state is correct. Suggestion: error text should read "Enter a Citizen Card OR a Residence Card number". Evidence: evidence/identification-required-next-disabled-redacted.png, recording 0:40-0:57.

Title: "Country" field state on step 1
Preconditions: Signed in; on step 1 "Personal Info"
Steps:
1. Hover over and click the "Country" field.
2. Try to change the value.
Expected result: Field shows "Portugal" (country of residence); whether it is editable follows the product rule.
Actual result: Field shows "Portugal", greyed out; pointer shows a "not-allowed" cursor; value cannot be changed.
Notes: Behaviour observed and recorded as a fact. It is not a defect by itself, but it means the form assumes the candidate is Portuguese. Evidence: evidence/country-field-locked-redacted.png (recording about 0:25).

Title: Form lets a non-Portuguese candidate state nationality or choose a document type
Preconditions: Signed in; on step 1 "Personal Info"
Steps:
1. Review all step 1 fields.
2. Look for a "Nationality" field or a document-type selector (e.g. Passport / Residence Permit / Citizen Card).
Expected result: The candidate can state nationality or choose an accepted identity document type.
Actual result: Step 1 fields visible: First name, Last name, Date of Birth, Country (locked), Mobile phone, Address block, and Identification (Cartão de Cidadão, Residence Card). No nationality field and no document-type selector.
Notes: Contributes to BUG-001. Evidence: screen recording and screenshots.

Title: Help or contact link available on the Identification step

Actual result: No help link or helper text is visible on step 1 in the evidence. Only a gear icon (bottom left) is visible.
